title: SPRK schema-v2 API for new plugins
description: Normative authoring schema for a new plugin root manifest.json or extension manifest. It intentionally excludes compatibility-only authoring shapes. The Go validator remains authoritative for bundle-wide references and source-catalog-dependent rules.

ConnectorExecutionPolicy.description: totalTimeoutMs must also be at least attemptTimeoutMs; the backend checks this cross-field rule.
